messages:
anya: heads up — CI scanner spiked this morning and a couple of PRs didn't get vulnerability annotations.
ci-bot: CI job failed: scanner-runner-5 exit code 1
ci-bot: last logs:
```
2024-06-15T08:12:34Z ERROR KMS decrypt failed: AccessDenied for key arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:...:key/abcd
2024-06-15T08:12:34Z INFO retrying (1/3)
2024-06-15T08:12:35Z ERROR scanner: failed to fetch manifest: 401
```
jon: @anya could be the service account token rotation we pushed yesterday? infra ran an RBAC tighten.
anya: yeah we've had svc-scan-role updated to remove sts:AssumeRole on non-prod — maybe the scanner's role lost kms:Decrypt.
olivia: quick check: iam policy for svc-scan-role shows kms:Decrypt allowed on key alias/redwood-scanner-key?
sam: i saw a rotation event in CloudTrail at 08:10 UTC for that key; KMS key policy was changed to exclude the scan role.
anya: ok can someone revert or add conditional? This is blocking triage for ~15 PRs.
jon: re-adding kms:Decrypt to svc-scan-role for the alias should unblock — but we should avoid broad policies. propose: add a scoped policy with resource = key ARN and condition on aws:SourceAccount.
olivia: concur. Also we should add guardrails: alert if CI sees KMS decrypt errors for >3 distinct builds in 10m.
anya: for the CVE side — two high findings surfaced: "CVE-2024-2468" in transitive dep `libfast-http` (CVSS 7.5) and "CVE-2024-1357" (moderate) in dev-only tooling. Prioritizing the libfast-http backport.
sam: do we have a list of impacted services? scanner output attached: `service-mapper` and `nlp-ingest`.
ci-bot: scan report: https://redwood-ci/reports/2098765432
jon: triage proposal: patch `service-mapper` (prod) within 24h, schedule `nlp-ingest` for next release; dev tooling low priority.
anya: agree. assign @jon to emergency PR for service-mapper, @olivia for release calendar update.
olivia: taking release update. I'll also add a post-deploy smoke to ensure KV cache not broken by new runtime.
anya: also we should adjust suppression rules — some old suppressions matched the transitive path and hid other findings. please review suppression list and add audit tag for any suppression >30d.
sam: noted. leaving a TODO: audit suppression -> https://docs/reports/suppressions
jon: quick mitigation for pipeline: temporary policy change pushed, scanners green now.
ci-bot: CI job passed: scanner-runner-6
anya: thanks. follow-ups: (1) patch service-mapper PR by noon UTC (owner: jon), (2) suppression audit (owner: sam), (3) update RBAC doc & add automated alert (owner: olivia).
olivia: I'll create the alert rule and link the runbook.
anya: tagging incident for postmortem in #incidents if the RBAC change was rolled via infra deploy without changebot note. @oncall FYI :eyes:
sam: adding a brief postmortem note and will collect CloudTrail events.
anya: closing thread after actions are in flight — please ping here when PRs merged / alerts live. :thumbsup:
